oracle_definitions.R1_numeric_type: same column names (same order) and row count; exactly one column differs; in it every reference cell is an integer (not bool) and the aligned candidate cell is a float with float(ref) == cand; all other columns identical (type-aware) row by row
oracle_definitions.R2_float_tolerance: same column names and row count; exactly one column differs; in it every aligned pair is two non-NaN floats with |cand - ref| <= 1e-09 * max(1, |ref|); at least one pair has a non-zero difference; all other columns identical row by row
oracle_definitions.R3_row_order: same column names; identical rows including types as multisets; row sequences differ; reference text has no ORDER BY / SKIP / LIMIT
oracle_definitions.R4_duplicates: same column names; reference has no duplicate rows; same set of distinct rows (types included); candidate has at least one duplicate row; candidate de-duplicated in first-occurrence order equals the reference sequence
oracle_definitions.R5_column_order: >= 2 columns; candidate column list is the reverse of the reference column list and differs from it; same row count; every row identical cell by cell when aligned by column name (type-aware); same row sequence
oracle_definitions.R6_reference_order: reference text has exactly one ORDER BY and no SKIP / LIMIT; candidate text has no ORDER BY; same column names; identical rows including types as multisets; row sequences differ
oracle_definitions.R7_list_order: same column names and row count; exactly one column differs; in it every aligned pair is two lists of scalars with the same elements as multisets (type-aware) and at least one row's list sequence differs; all other columns identical row by row
oracle_definitions.R8_null_natural: results identical including column names, types, row order and NULL positions; at least one NULL cell and at least one non-NULL cell (NULLs occur naturally; nothing is appended)
oracle_definitions.C0_column_name_control: study S18 T1 / study S20 D6 rule: same column count and value multiset; column names differ

label_note: Equivalence classes are declared, not claims that either result is 'correct'. R4 is SET_EQUIVALENT_MULTISET_DIFFERENT (not universally equivalent); R5 COLUMN_ORDER_POLICY, R6 REFERENCE_ORDERED_CANDIDATE_UNORDERED and R7 LIST_ORDER_POLICY are policy-profiling classes (intent-dependent); R8 uses naturally occurring NULLs only; C0 is a calibration control, not new evidence.
